# Final checklist

- [ ] At least one clear research question addressed (stats or visualization).

# Course recap

- **Session 1**: R workflow, Quarto, data import (CSV, tidytext, quanteda, LOD XML).
- **Session 2**: Data wrangling with dplyr and the pipe.
- **Session 3**: Statistics (descriptive, tests, linear models).
- **Session 4**: Visualization with ggplot2.
- **Sessions 5–6**: Applied project work.

# Further learning

- [R for Data Science (2e)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/)
- [R for Linguists](https://eleanorchodroff.com/r-for-linguists/)
- [Applied statistics for linguists](https://appliedstatisticsforlinguists.org/)
- Posit cheatsheets, community forums, and local R user groups.

Thank you for participating. Good luck with your language analytics in R!
